title: Add RecipeThumbnailView async thumbnail loader
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeThumbnailView.swift. Accepts thumbnailURL: URL? and loads the image asynchronously using Task / async file reads without blocking the main thread. Displays the image clipped to 56×56 pt. Falls back to fork.knife SF Symbol on a .tint-tinted square background of the same size when thumbnailURL is nil or loading fails. Uses a shared in-memory cache (e.g. a simple actor or NSCache keyed by URL) so list scrolling does not repeatedly read disk.
acceptance_criteria: Loads image from thumbnailURL asynchronously; main thread is not blocked
Displays loaded image at 56×56 pt fixed size
Falls back to fork.knife SF Symbol on .tint background when thumbnailURL is nil or loading fails
Image size is fixed at 56×56 pt regardless of Dynamic Type setting
In-memory cache prevents redundant disk reads when the same URL is encountered during scrolling
